title: Bitly | Page Not Found | 404
markdown:
Error 404 - Page not found

# You’ve got the wrong address.

You may have mis-typed the URL or simply clicked on a broken link or QR code. Bitly links are
CAse SeNsiTivE, so double check that everything is correct and try again.

If you continue to see this error, we suggest reaching out to the person or organization that shared it
with you. P.S. You do not need to sign up (or sign in) to access a Bitly link.

![Delivery person at a door with a 404 sign – page not found](https://bitly.com/static/graphics/404_error_page_desktop.png)
